title: Velvety Norwegian Potato Casserole
description: A comforting and crunchy Norwegian dish featuring sage, perfect for a cold winter night, with a low-calorie friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and melted butter, tossing to coat.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped sage, onion, garlic, salt, and pepper.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of the sage mixture, and then a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Pour the low-fat cream over the top layer of potatoes.
Sprinkle the whole wheat breadcrumbs over the top of the casserole.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with additional chopped sage if desired.
